attchmntText: Hilton Metal Forging Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Hilton Metal Forging Limited announced its quarterly standalone financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 13th November 2026. Revenue from operations was Rs 6,774.27 lacs. Profit after tax was Rs 202.74 lacs. Earnings per share was Rs 0.39. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs 12,669.89 lacs. Profit after tax was Rs 383.29 lacs. Earnings per share was Rs 0.74. The statutory auditors, Anil Bansal & Associates, issued a limited review report. The report stated that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements. The financial results were prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards.
